subject: Conference travel details
text:
Hi Professor,

Sorry if this is all over the place, but I have been trying to sort the conference travel and I think one piece may have slipped. The original flight I put on the calendar is not working well because it lands after the welcome session starts. I looked at the earlier option, but that one seems to involve a short layover, and I am not sure if that counts for reimbursement.

Also, the hotel reservation is still pending, or maybe it was confirmed? The email I got had a confirmation number, but I cannot find it. I can send it after I check the spam folder again. For the local transport, I suggested using the campus shuttle instead of rideshare, if that is allowed. It is slower, but maybe cleaner for the expense report.

If there is a better time for a call, let me know. I can also forward whatever receipts I have before leaving. I saw a rail option leaving the day before, it costs more, but gives a buffer if traffic goes wrong, so I can check approval before I book anything.
